resources.string: External screen safe area

Unifiedly adjust the layout and touch range of each interface of the assistant. The shortcut bar is always outside the safe area and no longer crowds out the internal content; when the white bar is too high or the white space is too large, it can be calibrated according to the direction.
Select the direction you want to set
automatic
Manual

Auto: Calculates based on screen, notch, and system edge lining, retaining navigation avoidance settings. When there is insufficient space outside, the shortcut bar will not be displayed temporarily. You can turn off navigation avoidance or manually reduce the safe area. Switching back to automatic will retain manual parameters.

Manual: Only adjusts the current direction, the shortcut bar uses the real available area outside the bounds. When there is insufficient space outside, the shortcut bar will not be displayed temporarily. You can reduce the safe area or restore it to automatic. Will not shut down the system Home or return gesture。
Show safe area auxiliary lines
Draw the current effective boundary on the outer screen without affecting touch. It will be displayed automatically during adjustment, and the selection of this switch will be restored after exiting.
